notes: Scope: 45 business data-flow writers (20 SDK script components + 25 OLE DB Commands on conn qsql = ALTSHULER_MSCRM) + 3 control-flow Execute SQL Tasks are mapped. Skipped as ETL plumbing: 5 × "insert etl process warning" (gen_etlprocesswarningBase) and "End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish", ETL counter Script Tasks, Create/Error ETL Process record.

All sources are SQL queries on the CRM database itself (conn qsql → psql / ALTSHULER_MSCRM): there are no flat-file fields. Source columns are described as <table>.<column> (alias) via query in <component>.

Create or Update: a fund whose (bank account number, customer account type) has no gen_customeraccount is CREATED via SDK (50 attributes); a matching account is UPDATED via SDK when the broker number changed/NULL (Conditional Split "Supported", per-attribute change detection) or via direct SQL when the broker is unchanged ("UnSupported": all 42 columns overwritten unconditionally) — in both cases only if the Compare script found a difference.

gen_productsubcustomeraccount has different sources by path: Create and SDK update use gen_customeraccounttype.gen_productsubcustomeraccount (cat); the SQL update binds Param_26 to input gen_subproduct = product.gen_subproduct (DTSX 41060), and the SQL-path Compare script never compares this column.

Create Customer Account sets gen_selfemployername from gen_accountname (main.cs:126-127); the gen_selfemployername input (f.gen_selfemployername) is unused there, while both update paths write gen_selfemployername from f.gen_selfemployername.

Create Customer Account sends gen_agentname as EntityReference("gen_agents") and gen_agencyname as EntityReference("gen_agencie"); the SDK update uses "contact" and "account" and Set Joining email joins Gen_agentname→Contact, Gen_agencyname→Account. Whether "gen_agents"/"gen_agencie" exist as entities is external_unknown (CRM metadata not supplied).

Create Customer Account: consulting fields (gen_consultnumber/gen_consultname/gen_consultingstartdate/gen_consultingenddate) are first taken from gen_fundmain and then overwritten by the Automated Joining values (advisor number, bank advisors, start/end advising date) when the LEFT Merge Join found an AJ row with joining status 7.

Update CustomerAccounts: needToUpdate is always true because gen_isaccountblockedfordeposits is never NULL (Derived Column TRUE/FALSE) — DirectRowToDontNeedToUpdate is unreachable; gen_mfratedtotal, gen_letterofbenefitindex and gen_isaccountblockedfordeposits are sent on every update without comparison.

'Create or Update Customer Accounts\Dates To Local' initialises minDate in PostExecute instead of PreExecute (main.cs:99-104), so on the SDK-update path the CrmMinimumDate sentinel is not excluded from ToLocalTime(); 'Dates To Local 1' and Connect Funds' 'Dates To Local' initialise it correctly in PreExecute.

Date handling differs by path: SDK paths send local-time DateTime for consulting/birth dates (Dates To Local), but other dates (deposit commission dates, commission dates, last deposit, employment started) are sent without conversion; SQL paths copy UTC DB values as-is.

Update Consulting Field In Fund Main: the source uses LEFT JOIN Gen_fundmain, so a transfer request whose account has no fund gives Gen_fundmainId NULL → 'Update Fund Main' updates 0 rows without error and the request is still stamped gen_dateofcopyingconsultingdetailstofund.

gen_transferrequest is updated through the CRM view name (update gen_transferrequest), not gen_transferrequestBase; ModifiedOn is set but VersionNumber/plugins are bypassed (all SQL writers are Unsupported).

Update TransactionCurrencyId uses User::CurrencyName, whose only value in the package is the design-time literal "שקל חדש" (DTSX 29); Set Variables only sets CrmMinimumDate, OrganizationName and ServerName.

Copies of each writer are fed round-robin by Add Row Number (counter % 5) + Split Rows For MultiThread; the split is load balancing, not business filtering. Note Split Rows For MultiThread 2 sends Case 3 to "Update CustomerAccounts 4" and Case 4 to "Update CustomerAccounts 3".
Script analysis is based on the C# source in the DTSX; compiled DLLs and the external CRM2015.Proxy assembly (CrmProxy, ExecuteMultipleExtension) were not decompiled.
